title: Efficient Wide-Beam Generative Retrieval with Model-Native Trie Decoding and Shared-Context Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.22309v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) predicts catalog entries as short semantic identifiers (SIDs). Trie-constrained beam search keeps these identifiers valid, but wide beams expose two serving costs: vocabulary-wide score tensors that are mostly discarded, and repeated attention over the same prompt. We present Trie-Head, a model-native output interface that stores the identifier trie as validated GPU tensors. Compared with a Python custom logit processor (CLP), it reduces CPU--GPU coordination and memory traffic by avoiding Python constraint callbacks and vocabulary-wide candidate buffers. It scores compact codebook candidates and streams the full-vocabulary normalizer, preserving the original model's valid-token scores in real arithmetic without retraining. translated_title: 基于模型原生Trie解码与共享上下文注意力的高效宽束生成式检索
translated_abstract: 生成式检索（GR）将目录条目预测为短语义标识符（SIDs）。基于Trie约束的束搜索可以保证这些标识符的有效性，但宽束搜索暴露了两个服务开销：大部分会被丢弃的全词表分数张量，以及对同一提示词的重复注意力计算。我们提出了Trie-Head，这是一种模型原生的输出接口，它将标识符Trie存储为经过验证的GPU张量。与Python自定义logit处理器（CLP）相比，它通过避免Python约束回调以及全词表候选缓冲区，减少了CPU与GPU之间的协调和内存流量。它对紧凑的码本候选进行评分，并流式传输全词表归一化器，在真实算术中保留原始模型的有效token分数，而无需重新训练。共享上下文注意力对这一输出路径形成补充，通过在多个束之间复用提示词的key/value块，同时保留各束私有的解码尾部。我们在SGLang中实现了这两种机制并对其进行评估。
tldr: 本文提出Trie-Head模型原生输出接口与共享上下文注意力机制，通过将标识符Trie存为GPU张量、避免全词表评分和重复注意力计算，在不重训模型的情况下大幅提升宽束生成式检索的服务效率。
en_tdlr: Trie-Head, a model-native output interface that stores the identifier trie as validated GPU tensors, combined with shared-context attention, eliminates vocabulary-wide scoring and repeated attention overhead to enable efficient wide-beam generative retrieval without retraining.
